title: fix: explain agent pricing in the model catalog and MCP
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Clarified agent pricing in the model catalog schemas and MCP documentation. Agents add no charge of their own, but callers pay for the model and tool calls they make; a currency-only pricing entry without a base_model does not mean a request is free. Prompt agents show their base model’s rates, while agents without a base_model have usage-dependent charges. MCP’s getUsage description now explains that agent calls appear under the models the agent called. Response fields and prices are unchanged.
